signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a residential frontage with a green-gray house, though a large evergreen tree and foliage partly obscure the left side of the facade.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Mulched circular bed with flowers and ornamental grasses near the house look tidy, but nothing shows crew-level work such as crews, equipment or trailers.

signals.notes: Well-kept home with a mowed lawn that has a few dry or thin patches, mature trees, and a neat landscaped island bed; the driveway on the right is mostly out of frame.
